title: Midweek runtime + infra + console sync — quick plan
body:
Purpose: quick midweek checkpoint across serving runtime / infra / console. Keep it tight (30–40m). This doc is a scratchpad — will copy clean agenda into Slack + calendar invite. Priorities: 1) unblock Canary rollout for 2.3.1, 2) confirm autoscaler thresholds for Dedicated pools, 3) Console trace UI regression triage.

Notes to self:
- Ask SRE if there were DB connection spikes Tuesday 01:00-03:00 — follow up with traces.
- Bring up the observed latency tail for 512-token jobs (p95 moved +20ms) — might be kernel fallbacks.
- Remind product that A/B rollout window ends Friday; need rollback plan if quality regressions show up.

Agenda (30–40m):
1) Quick opens (5m) — wins + blockers (each team rep: 30s)
2) Canary rollout status (10m) — Arjun to present current traffic %, error budget, flaky routes (focus: 2.3.1)
3) Autoscaler thresholds proposal (8m) — discuss proposal + quick decision (Liam owns)
4) Console trace/regression triage (8m) — reproduce steps, suspected causes, short-term mitigations (Sofia owns)
5) Action items & owners (4m) — confirm and assign
6) Parking lot / async follow-ups (2m)

Pre-reads (copy into invite):
- Canary dashboard link (GH-PR-2187)
- Autoscaler proposal doc (confluence:RT-4021)
- Recent error logs snapshot (link pinned in #runtime-incidents)

Meeting logistics:
- Timebox: 35m (flex +5 if needed).
- Attendees: runtime leads, infra autoscale owner, console UI lead, SRE on-call if available.
- Recording: optional — only for notes.

Open questions to surface during meeting:
- Do we accept +10% temporary overprovision to stabilize canary? Pros/cons briefly.
- If console trace regression is a downstream lib, do we hotfix or roll back UI change? Impact on customers?
- Any capacity constraints this weekend (scheduled maintenance)?

Rough script for Arjun: present canary % history, top 3 failing routes, which tests failed in CI, current rollback blockers.
Rough script for Liam: show before/after autoscale baseline numbers, proposed new thresholds, estimate cost delta (hours/day).
Rough script for Sofia: reproduce error in UI, attach short video or step list, include stack traces and suspect commit hash.

Parking lot (async):
- Deep-dive kernel selection metrics (move to next week).
- Long-term autoscale policy engine (quarterly project).

Notes for post-meeting follow-up:
- I will create a short Slack thread summarizing decisions + tag owners.
- Write a one-paragraph status for product and CS if we change rollout cadence.
- Add any new test failures to the canary regression board (Linear).

Style / tone: keep it pragmatic, avoid long debates in sync — use follow-ups for long investigations.

Random TODO for myself: check my calendar for Friday on-call conflict and swap if needed.
action_items: Arjun — finalize canary rollback checklist and post to Linear by 2026-03-14
Liam Chen — run cost estimate for +10% overprovision and share as a short spreadsheet by 2026-03-15
Sofia Romano — reproduce console trace regression and attach reproduction steps + suspect commit by 2026-03-13
Priya Menon — post meeting summary in #runtime-ops and update Canary board (Linear) by 2026-03-13
On-call SRE (TBD) — check DB connection spike logs for Tue 01:00-03:00 and report findings by 2026-03-13
